correctness.rationale: ACFA is model-complete, so every same-language extension R is model-complete. Any completion R-prime of a consistent R extending ACFA is a completion of ACFA. Beyarslan--Kowalski Theorem 1.2 rules out a model companion for (R-prime)_tau, while their Corollary 6.2 would force one for every completion if R_tau had one. This contradiction proves the universal claim.

evidence: Beyarslan--Kowalski prove nonexistence for every completion of ACFA and a separate transfer theorem for completions of a model-complete theory.
Hyttinen--Kangas treat fields with several commuting automorphisms through an AEC framework rather than this same-language hereditary model-companion theorem.
Kikyo gives general obstruction criteria under hypotheses not used in the accepted argument.
broader_coverage.reasoning: The new claim is not a special case of a stronger checked prior theorem; it is obtained by combining the recent all-completions result with the recent transfer result and model-completeness inheritance.

value.rationale: The conclusion eliminates every same-language first-order repair of the new all-completions obstruction, including incomplete strengthenings. This is a natural structural closure property of the model-companion failure and identifies the entire cone above ACFA as obstructed, rather than just its complete nodes.
